claim_ceiling: The fixtures test observable transition, evidence, self-report and causal-layer separation. They do not inspect hidden model states, establish human psychology, or prove causal effects outside matched experiments. Confidence values are self-reports unless bound to an external calibration profile and receipt; a structural record does not prove that calibration is valid or transferable.
